name: A sealed grader whose digest the run did not approve halts the run before the cycle
description: With an approved list containing x and a different fixture rubric digest, the run halted at grader for refused-before-the-cycle, naming the computed sha256 digest. It recorded no self-check or fence and no builder was configured or launched.
